title: The Tale of the Husband and the Parrot

paragraphs.en: Once upon a time, there was a jealous husband whose wife was incredibly beautiful. She refused to let him travel alone until one day he needed to go on a journey for business. He bought a smart parrot from the bird market and brought it home.
paragraphs.zh: 从前，有个嫉妒心很强的丈夫，他的妻子美丽非凡。妻子坚决不让他单独出行，直到有一天他需要出差。于是，他在鸟市买了一只聪明的鹦鹉带回家。

paragraphs.en: Upon his return, the husband inquired about his wife's activities during his absence. The parrot recounted every detail of her affair with another man. Enraged, the husband beat his wife, suspecting one of her maids had informed him.
paragraphs.zh: 丈夫归来后，询问妻子在他不在期间的行踪。鹦鹉详尽地复述了她与另一男人私通的每一件事。丈夫听后怒不可遏，怀疑是其中一个女仆告了他的状，于是对妻子施以暴打。

paragraphs.en: However, when he interrogated the maids, they all swore it was the parrot.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当他质问女仆们时，她们都发誓是鹦鹉干的。

paragraphs.en: When the wife learned the truth, she ordered three maids to torment the parrot: grinding stones under its cage, sprinkling water over it, and walking with a mirror all night. The husband returned home in the morning, asked the parrot about that night's events, and heard the same story.
paragraphs.zh: 妻子得知真相后，命令三个婢女折磨鹦鹉：在笼底放磨石，往它身上洒水，并整夜拿着镜子围着它转。丈夫翌日回家，问鹦鹉昨晚的情况，鹦鹉重复了同样的故事。

paragraphs.en: Seeing it was summer, he retorted, "This is no season for rain." The parrot insisted it had seen everything. Believing the parrot had lied, the husband killed it.
paragraphs.zh: 见是夏天，他反驳道：“现在可不是下雨的时候。”鹦鹉坚持说自己见识过一切。丈夫认为鹦鹉在撒谎，便将其处死。

paragraphs.en: Later, neighbors told him the parrot had spoken truthfully, leading to his regret over killing it.
paragraphs.zh: 后来，邻居告诉他鹦鹉说得没错，这让他后悔不已，竟亲手害死了它。

paragraphs.en: King Yunan concluded, "The same will happen to me."
paragraphs.zh: 云南王叹了口气，说道：“同样的事情也会发生在我的身上。”

paragraphs.en: The next night, Dinarzad urged her sister Shahrazad to continue a story. "Please, tell us one of your tales," she said. Shahrazad agreed with pleasure.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，迪纳兹达催促她的姐姐沙赫拉兹达继续讲一个故事。“求求你，给我们讲一个你的故事吧。”她说道。沙赫拉兹达愉快地答应了。

paragraphs.en: The king added that he wanted the tale about King Yunan and his wise vizier.
paragraphs.zh: 国王补充说他想听关于云安国王和他的贤明辅臣的故事。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad began: "O happy king, I heard that after the husband killed the parrot, he regretted it deeply when neighbors told him the truth. Similarly, my envious vizier feared you might kill a wise man and later regret it."
paragraphs.zh: 沙赫拉兹阿德说道：“哦，幸福的国王，我听说那位丈夫在邻居们告诉他真相后，对杀掉鹦鹉一事深感后悔。同样地，我的嫉妒的首相也担心您可能会杀害一位智者，事后也会后悔不已。”

paragraphs.en: The vizier responded to King Yunan's words with concern: "Great king, what harm has this sage done? I speak out of love for you. If you doubt me, let me suffer like the deceitful vizier who tricked your son."
paragraphs.zh: vizier 对国王云安的话表达了关切：“陛下，贤者又有什么过错呢？我这是出于对您的爱。如果您不信，请让我承受像那个欺骗您儿子的奸臣一样的惩罚。”
